def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params

    c1 = np.cos(w*t); s1 = np.sin(w*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*v*np.abs(v)
            + p[3]*c1 + p[4]*s1 + p[5]*x*c1 + p[6]*x*s1
            + p[7]*np.cos(2*w*t) + p[8]*np.sin(2*w*t) + p[9]*np.cos(3*w*t))
